As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will return tomorrow and be broadcast on Apple TV, with related features launching simultaneously on Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+, and other platforms. Details are as follows.

MLS returns on Apple TV

Apple today announced the return of Apple League Soccer, with six matches scheduled in the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs. Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire FC vs. Vancouver Whitecaps FC (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs. Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders FC vs. Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs. Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs. LAFC (10:15 PM ET)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple announced a range of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The new episode is hosted by German football legend Thomas Müller, who will "reflect on the hard work before fame, and share how he embraces life's major transitions."

Apple Music will also roll out a number of exclusive playlists personally curated by players including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, alongside themed playlists from the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, Orlando City SC, and multiple other Eastern and Western Conference clubs.

On Apple Maps, Apple will introduce "bespoke matchday guides produced by MLS clubs, and city guides created by the players themselves, offering restaurant picks for watching matches, city exploration tips, and detailed stadium information."

Users who rely on the Apple Sports app can keep up to date with the latest league information, including live scores, standings, play-by-play text updates, lineups, and team statistics.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are available free of charge to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide. Apple will also offer exclusive content, as well as exclusive viewing rights to various cup competitions and the playoffs throughout the season.

To learn more about Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please click this link.

Apple TV is priced at US$12.99 per month, and is also available through the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a range of popular series and films, including "Severance," "The Studio," "The Morning Show," "Shrinking," and "Silo."
